title: The scheduled() handler is the sole reader of the Cron Trigger event and opens on boot with cronReady
description: The applying project reaches Cloudflare Workers Cron Triggers through a single scheduled() handler module in the project source tree that is the ONLY module holding a reference to the Cron Trigger event (env is the wrangler runtime; the handler surface is documented at https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/runtime-apis/handlers/scheduled/). On process boot, the handler wires the dispatcher module and the injected event sink and emits a cronReady lifecycle event with a metadata-only payload. The Cloudflare compatibility date is elicited on the deploy-cloudflare-workers blueprint; every scheduled trigger the applied project declares lands in wrangler.toml under [triggers] crons per https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/configuration/cron-triggers/. The scheduled handler MUST NOT dereference other bindings on env (env.CACHE stays owned by the platform-cloudflare-kv facade); consumer domain code that needs KV imports the platform-cloudflare-kv facade from its own module boundary. Delivers the declared `scheduledTrigger` capability token: the single scheduled() handler module is the runtime that supplies the token, so once the applying project boots the handler the `scheduledTrigger` promise binds every cron expression the Worker registers.
rationale: Ratified in the Cloudflare round 6 spec (2026-09-06 section 5.2). Ships as v1.0.0 of platform-cloudflare-cron-triggers.
